tree.title: Family Tree
tree.createNamePlaceholder: Family tree name, e.g. "Gia phả họ Nguyễn"
tree.noTreeYet: You don't have a family tree yet.

pedigree.shows: The selected person and their ancestors: parents, grandparents, and so on up the line.
pedigree.hides: Siblings, aunts and uncles, the person's own spouse and children, and any step-parent who isn't a recorded parent.

descendant.shows: The selected person, all of their children, grandchildren and further descendants, and each of those people's spouses.
descendant.hides: The person's parents and ancestors, their siblings, and the parents of the spouses who married in.

familyGroup.shows: The selected person, their spouse or spouses, and their children (plus a child's other recorded parent).
familyGroup.hides: The person's parents and siblings, grandchildren, and the spouses of the children.

fan.shows: The selected person at the center, with their ancestors in concentric rings around them: parents in the first ring, grandparents in the next, and so on. The father's line fills the left half and the mother's line the right half.
fan.hides: Siblings, aunts and uncles, the person's own spouse and children, and any step-parent who isn't a recorded parent. Ancestors beyond nine generations are cut off.

extended.shows: Go up the chosen number of generations from the selected person (1 = parents, 2 = grandparents, ...) and show everyone descended from those ancestors: siblings, aunts and uncles, cousins and their children, together with their spouses. Use the − / + control to widen or narrow the reach.
extended.hides: The parents and relatives of spouses who married in, and anyone further up than the chosen number of generations.

hourglass.shows: The selected person's ancestors above them, and their children, grandchildren and further descendants below, with spouses.
hourglass.hides: Siblings, aunts, uncles and cousins, and the parents of spouses who married in.

kinship.shows: The selected person, a second person you choose, and the chain of ancestors joining them through their closest common ancestor. The relationship is spelled out above the chart, using Vietnamese terms (bác, chú, cô, dì, cậu, cháu nội, ...) when the app is in Vietnamese.
kinship.hides: Everyone else: siblings and other relatives who are not part of the connection.

kinship.hint: Choose a second person to see how they are related to {{name}}.
kinship.none: No family connection was found between {{a}} and {{b}}.
